title: The Unjust Judge
description: Jesus tells a parable about an unjust judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought. A widow kept coming to him, asking for justice against her adversary. Finally, the judge granted her request just to get rid of her. Jesus uses this parable to teach his disciples that they should always pray and never give up, because God will quickly bring justice to his chosen ones. [ref:Luk 18:1-8|Luke 18:1-8]
